decisions.decision: Dual-server pattern with separate CLI and control sockets
decisions.rationale: Matches Phase 1 daemon expectations and provides clear separation of concerns

decisions.decision: Control protocol uses length-prefixed JSON (4-byte length header)
decisions.rationale: Phase 1 daemon uses this format; NDJSON mentioned in plan was inaccurate

decisions.decision: Credentials via stdin, not environment variables
decisions.rationale: Prevents credential leakage via /proc and enables secure spawn

decisions.decision: Session token for CLI authentication stored in adapter.expected_session_token
decisions.rationale: Matches dummy adapter pattern and provides stateless CLI auth

decisions.decision: CLI tunnel commands use AdapterClient directly after adapter startup
decisions.rationale: Enables multi-tunnel session reuse without re-authentication; avoids legacy D-Bus for new flow

decisions.decision: Legacy ManagerClient.create_tunnel preserved for backward compatibility
decisions.rationale: Ensures existing scripts and tools continue to work

decisions.decision: Integration tests stubbed due to missing Proton core
decisions.rationale: Tests will be completed when mock or real dependency is available; structure is in place
